summary: Frontend-only validation of admin tab navigation feature on Ross House Rentals Expo app (mobile web, 390x844). Injected admin role via localStorage using the provided marketplace tenant JWT (role-override technique). All 6 scenarios pass visually and via DOM/URL assertions: (1) admin lands on /dashboard with 'Panel de Admin' and exactly 5 tabs Panel/Propiedades/Mensajes/Finanzas/Perfil (no Inicio/Mercado); (2) each admin tab renders embedded content without a back arrow — Propiedades shows management screen with 'Nueva' + search, Mensajes shows 'Mensajes' with Todos/App/Web source tabs, Finanzas shows Reporte Fiscal card; (3) Perfil shows 'Modo de vista' with 'Ver como inquilino' which switches to tenant home (URL '/', Bienvenido..., no Panel de Admin banner, no admin quick actions) and tenant tabs (Inicio, Propiedades, Mercado, Pagos, Perfil); (4) In tenant-view Perfil the item flips to 'Volver a vista Admin' and switches back to /dashboard; (5) view_as_tenant persists in localStorage across reload and lands on /dashboard; (6) Tenant regression: clean state with user_role='tenant' shows tenant tabs and Perfil has no 'Modo de vista' section. As instructed, 403s from /api/admin/* and $0 dashboard stats were ignored because the injected JWT is a tenant token with role overridden locally. No React Native / Expo deprecation issues detected in the tab layout, dashboard, messages, finances, or profile files inspected.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly gates tabs by role/viewAsTenant via href: undefined|null pattern — clean.
AuthContext.tsx persists view_as_tenant to AsyncStorage/localStorage and initializes on mount — persistence verified in test.
admin-properties.tsx respects the `embedded` prop to hide back arrow when rendered inside the Propiedades tab — verified visually (no top-left back arrow).
seed_data_creation: None. Used provided marketplace tenant JWT + localStorage override for admin view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real admin 2FA login cannot be tested from sandbox (OTP email unreachable). Use localStorage injection: ross_rental_token=<marketplace tenant JWT>, user_role='admin' (or 'tenant'), onboarding_completed='true', view_as_tenant='0'. Tab bar elements are anchors <a href='/route'> — navigating via page.goto('/properties'|'/messages'|'/finances'|'/profile') is the most reliable way to test admin tab screens. Ignore /api/admin/* 403s and $0 stats when using the tenant-token role override.
